name: Apify
tagline: Actors, proxies, scraping, and browser automation at scale.
shortDescription: A mature scraping and automation platform with actors, storage, APIs, SDKs, and marketplace patterns.
agentSummary: Agents can run existing actors, create automation tasks, inspect datasets, and connect outputs into workflows.
bestFor: Reusable scraping actors, scheduled crawls, proxies, and dataset pipelines.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Actor quality varies; marketplace actors should be reviewed before automation. Respect robots.txt, site terms, rate limits, copyright, authentication boundaries, and anti-bot controls before asking an agent to crawl or extract content. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public platform pricing with free credits and compute/usage dimensions.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup; billing needed for larger usage.
browserSupport: Console is usable for actor setup and inspection.

capabilities.detail: CLI supports actor development and platform operations.
API covers actors, runs, datasets, key-value stores, and schedules.
Official docs are listed for API behavior, authentication, limits, examples, and setup review.
Public platform pricing with free credits and compute/usage dimensions.
Self-serve signup; billing needed for larger usage.
Console is useful when choosing and configuring actors.
The tool has documented test, local, preview, self-hosted, or staging paths that let agents validate changes away from production.
